<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-0216-38-41" status="unreviewed">dang po la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs></rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs></note> na re dgag bya bkag nas chos gzhan mi 'phen pa de med dgag
               <lb n="32b3"/> kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin te | stong nyid 'di dgag byo bden dngos bkag nas chos gzhan 'phang du med pas stong nyid med dgag yin pa bzhin || yang dgag bya bkag nas chos gzhan 'phen pa de sgrub pa'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin te | sgyu ma lta bu 'di dgag bya bden dngos bkag nas snang pa 'phen pas ma yin dgag zin no zhes zer ba ni 
               ma yin te | dngos 'gal gyi dgag bya la myed
               <lb n="32b4"/>dam rgyud 'gal gyi dgag bya la byed | dang po ltar na sgyu ma lta bu yang dgag chos su thal te dngos 'gal gyi dgag bya bkag nas chos 'phang du med pa'i phyir dang | gnyis pa ltar na stong nyid kyang sgrub chos su 'gyur te rgyud 'gal gyi dgag bya bkag nas chos gzhan 'phen pa'i phyir || </seg></TEI>
